verdict.rationale: PyAirbyte is an official Python library aimed at Python and AI developers for extracting data into caches, and Airbyte also documents a public API and an official Terraform provider for programmatic control. However, the pack shows only one language SDK, and PyAirbyte is described as a connector and data-loading library rather than a full platform API client. missing for 10: official SDKs in multiple languages, an SDK that wraps the Airbyte API itself, SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
